nonBlockingIssues.description: OpenCode buildDispatcherCommand() silently ignores systemPrompt parameter — works correctly via caller compensation but could benefit from a code comment
Unused EngineCommandOptions import in test file (minor lint)
No tool restriction attempted for OpenCode dispatcher (accepted limitation given OpenCode CLI doesn't easily support it)
VAL-DISP-008 test exercises registry lookup error path rather than the Bun.which() binary-not-found code path
Minor import style inconsistency: resolveModels uses dynamic import while autoDetectTransport is static in flywheel-shell.tsx
parseModelString() does not validate empty string input — not practically exploitable
Auto-detect test only verifies CLI fallback path (SDK path requires running server)
extractTextFromNDJSON duplicated verbatim between dispatcher and evaluator transports — DRY violation
Minor evaluator system prompt duplication between EVALUATOR_SYSTEM_PROMPT constant and buildPrompt() for Claude route
Evaluator transport is not yet wired into the production execution pipeline (invoke.ts still uses legacy path)
Type assertion on CLI engineArg input trusts string before runtime validation
Engine binary availability test has limited coverage when both engines are installed locally

appliedUpdates.description: Updated .factory/library/architecture.md: replaced stale 'currently transports bypass engine registry' text with current state (dispatcher uses registry, evaluator refactored but not yet wired). Added documentation for engine-specific system prompt handling (Claude via --system-prompt flag, OpenCode via manual stdin prepend). Added OpenCode SDK API surface knowledge (SessionPromptData.body model and tools fields).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add clarification that the 'no console.error/console.warn/console.debug' rule applies to production TUI code only, not standalone diagnostic scripts (scripts/). Scripts that output to terminal as their primary purpose should use console.log/console.error directly.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: scripts/verify-dispatcher.ts uses console.log and console.error for diagnostic output, which is appropriate for a CLI tool. The current AGENTS.md wording ('Never use console.error/console.warn/console.debug in production code') is slightly ambiguous about whether scripts count.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: when mirroring external SDK types (like @opencode-ai/sdk SessionPromptData), add a comment referencing the source type path so future workers can verify the mirror is still accurate when the SDK updates.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: dispatcher-sdk-transport-optimization created an inline SdkClient type that mirrors SessionPromptData.body shape from @opencode-ai/sdk. If the SDK types change, the inline mirror could silently diverge.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: shared utility functions that appear in both dispatcher and evaluator transports (e.g., extractTextFromNDJSON) should be extracted to a shared module (src/utils/ or src/worker/) rather than duplicated. This prevents drift when the NDJSON format changes.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: extractTextFromNDJSON is copy-pasted identically in src/dispatcher/subprocess-transport.ts:37 and src/evaluator/subprocess-transport.ts:42 (15 lines each). Both features' reviewers flagged this independently.

rejectedObservations.observation: services.yaml should document --engine and --help flags for verify-dispatcher command
rejectedObservations.reason: services.yaml captures base commands only; flags are documented in the script's --help output. Adding flags to services.yaml creates a maintenance burden without clear value.
